changes.reason: Resolve encoded Flight suffix aliases for RSC pages and keep explicit routes ahead of aliases. The request path stays encoded and the matched RSC route still enforces the client manifest.

kubernetes.reason: The local Node fetch adapter and default Flight encoder serve the Unicode page and its refresh. The test decodes the refresh payload and verifies the response to a stale manifest.
constraints: The default encoder needs Node child_process and matching React Flight dependencies.
Route matching requires no storage or host lifecycle changes.
The host test runs locally without a Kubernetes deployment.

evidence.testName: rsc real Flight path serves a Unicode page and its Flight refresh through the Node adapter

aws-lambda.reason: The route matcher is shared, while the Lambda adapter provides invocation context that the default isolated Flight encoder does not accept.
constraints: Flight execution with an injected encoder was not exercised on Lambda.

cloudflare.reason: The default isolated Flight encoder needs Node child_process and does not accept Workers bindings or executionContext.
constraints: The fix supplies no Workers encoder and has no Node Container verification.
